notes.title: Turning the Cogs of Fate
notes.notes:
[h3]Dive Deep[/h3]

Dreams seem to follow their own logic. They wrap all around you, live their own life, and create their own story; very few are able to take control of their own dreams. So controlling the dreams of somebody else should prove downright impossible, then?

Not quite. As an outsider, you cannot shape the dream of Flawless Abbey as you see fit. However, as a Dreamseeker, perhaps you can give it a small nudge in the right direction…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3fI2jsj.gif[/img][i]What seems like a small detail might sometimes lead to bigger things…[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WTFm9RV.png[/img][i]The way is open to you, if you pay attention.[/i]

[h3]Take Hold[/h3]

There is no sense in analyzing dream logic, one should simply follow it. Flawless Abbey gives you, the Dreamseeker, various tools to indirectly influence the story. The most crucial tool is the lever, which can interact with and lead to many things. Click the left mouse button, feel its grip, and take hold.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mZzJ3bp.gif[/img][i]Open the smallest doors…[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z0FrOsj.gif[/img][i]…And the largest gates.[/i]

Once you grab the lever—spin away with your mouse! It’s not just the doors that can be brought into motion, but various mechanisms, and even the largest structures within the Tower. Manipulating those might require putting all of your strength into that spin, though…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TIhHFnb.gif[/img][i]Not all things turn the same way.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rlrcuL5.gif[/img][i]Nothing in life comes without patience.[/i]

[h3]Find the Way[/h3]

However, physical strength alone is not enough. The Tower is an endless maze waiting to devour you, so might not always makes right. To navigate the dream properly, you will have to keep your wits about you, pay attention, collect items, and sometimes even take unexpected detours. Only those with a keen eye can navigate the Tower’s living walls and not fall prey to fear and illusion. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uX0N9sm.gif[/img][i]Not all keys bear meaning. Follow the true way.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4cAoi9M.png[/img][i]The clues are there for those willing to find them.[/i]

The right way is not always a narrow path. Look closer and you just might find more than meets the eye. To break through the nightmare, you will have to use all of your senses: tough, sight, and sound. Hear the Tower’s song with the Sonant Gyratorium, rotate it at the proper pace with your key, and unlock new floors of the Tower. But beware: failing to do so will eventually cause it to break and shatter. You will still be able to proceed further, but might have to face dire consequences…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ySISZb3.gif[/img][i]Curiosity has its rewards.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qqAJdHp.gif[/img][i]Hear the Tower’s song and move the Sonant Gyratorium.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fkaBZ0A.gif[/img][i]Sometimes, you have to put all of your strength into your cause.[/i]

This is just the beginning of the trials and tribulations that await within the Tower. Whatever happens in Flawless Abbey, prepare to be challenged and to face lies and deceit. Take the plunge, and may your Dive bear fruit.

notes.title: The Mind’s Dark Maze
notes.notes:
[h3]The Dream[/h3]

A person’s mind can be a fascinating display of their personality: it holds our dreams, wants, convictions, aspirations. But as with everything, there is a darker side lurking beneath. Insecurities, fears, hidden desires… sins.

As a Dreamseeker, it is your job to dive deep into other people’s mind palaces, tearing away at their very cores. The dream of Flawless Abbey should be no different.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lm1hliK.gif[/img]
[i]In your mind’s prison, what would a Dragon represent?..[/i]

[h3]The Veil[/h3]

But dreams are not simply repositories of desire and fear: they are mired in illusion. Reality is not always as we remember. As time passes, one will encounter lies, and some even display the strangest proclivity to lie to themselves. What would it be like to see the mind of someone who doesn’t realize they are hiding from their own selves?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T94Pk80.gif[/img]
[i]No task more pointless than running in circles.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nyUESG2.gif[/img]
[i]Revisiting old memories can be dangerous. The places and people you wish to hold onto might simply not be there…[/i]

[h3]The Truth[/h3]

The mind is a maze, yet it also hides that which we hold most dear. How can something so fleeting have such a great power over us? Standing on the precipice of truth and delusion is the only way to unlock that which lies within.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LVP7zWs.gif[/img]
[i]Some walls are steadfast. Others — paper thin.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4JFVB40.gif[/img]
[i]Not all dreams bear meaning. Sometimes, it’s apt to look at the bigger picture.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s43ThcW.gif[/img]
[i]Nothing more exposing than the little things.[/i]

[h3]The Gaze[/h3]

Yet [i]this[/i] dream is not static. Flawless Abbey is not a museum filled with personal curios, existing for someone’s scorn or fascination. It is a living, breathing being and it welcomes you in its maw.
Will you cooperate, shatter it asunder, or be devoured by it?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MMK4YOJ.gif[/img]
[i]As you glimpse into the dream of another, it twists and contorts around you.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mwaKtVF.gif[/img]
[i]Even if you live by someone else’s script, you can still try giving things a small nudge…[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3RNM8ng.gif[/img]
[i]At least you are not alone… are you?[/i]

No matter what preconceptions hold you of this darker realm, whether your intentions are pure or not — Welcome to Flawless Abbey. And may your Dive bear fruit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U4Ei88Y.gif[/img]

notes.title: Flawless Abbey: Building the World of Your Dreams
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings, Dreamseekers![/b][/h3]

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to bend the laws of reality? To make the impossible possible? 

Today we shall take another peek behind the curtain while the overall construction of Flawless Abbey continues. But don't worry, We won't spill any big secrets just yet. That's part of the magic! That and well…no one likes spoilers, we would never wish such a dreadful fate upon our esteemed audience here tonight. 

At this stage in construction many of the Abbey’s secrets must remain hidden, we hope you understand, and we guarantee the big reveal is worth all the anticipation. What we can share, however, is the architects report construction is going well and proceeding according to plan!

[b]Moving on, we promised you a peek and a peek you shall get, presenting:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/299957a88bbf22d79db6b953680dcb35deb77dd6.png[/img]

[b]…this! Without any context whatsoever! [/b]

The only way for you to find out if it was an incredibly spoilerific moment, or something a little less vital is to visit the Abbey for yourselves…eventually!

Now, where was I? Oh yes, I wanted to thank everyone who’s played our demo on Steam and stopped by to say hello at live events over the past few months! Not unlike the Tower of Babel, it takes a terrific amount of work and effort to keep up the construction of the Flawless Abbey as well. But your love, encouragement, and feedback give us all the strength we need to keep moving forward against the dreaded Development Dragon. 
(please note: this is not the name of the Dragon in our story, he’s a distant cousin)

Now, going back to that tower, we have a question for all of you in the audience today: [i]what are your thoughts about the Labyrinth Tower?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/af2d7d5982f8fbf02a77e8164cd88ea0dc84e93d.png[/img]

Any of these answers are valid, really. To be technical, anything else would be also, as we exist outside The Story and are not tied by scripted narratives. 

The architects (us) consider it to be all three at once: a frightening display of the human condition in all of its glory and ruin. At least, that was our intention 

I didn’t mention Tower of Babel for nothing — Bruegel’s paintings have been a specific inspiration for us from the very beginning of the Abbey all the way back in its concept stages. It is a place where our deepest secrets will be laid bare, and where our true selves are revealed. 

Since most events of the Flawless Abbey are happening from inside the Tower, we wanted it to make an extra impression on our Dreamseekers right from the very beginning. This is your destination, your destiny awaits in this place - whatever it may be. Will your story be one of hope or despair? Of triumph or tragedy? 

It’s obviously a rather significant place, right? So wouldn’t it be a shame if this Tower just… disappeared?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/556e5c6cba2df8ded3dbcb3897948cd121641af5.gif[/img]

🔔[b]*DING*[/b]🔔

Unfortunately, our train has arrived back at the entrance to “Spoiler Territory” so we’ll have to cut things short for now. Until next time! Spare a moment to wishlist our game here on Steam and follow us on our socials to get more in-development content (and also because it makes the architects’ days!). 

We’ll meet again soon, dreamseekers!

[Dream Catcher Disengaged]

notes.title: Breathing Life Into Brushstrokes 🖌️
notes.notes:
Welcome back Dream Divers! ✨

Today, we wanted to take you all on a little walk down memory lane, and see how far we’ve come in creating Flawless Abbey’s majestic but terrifying [b]Beast[/b]. 🐉

Fun fact: Dragons represent wisdom and protection in many cultures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/ee27ba8d7af4b7767025780f6fb06a2d840399c2.png[/img]
The initial concept for the fearsome fire-breathing beast of Flawless Abbey was partially influenced by the creatures found crawling the pages of [i]Dragonology: The Complete Book of Dragons[/i]. A 2003 fictional book written by Dugald Steer about all the different dragons of the world; their biology, behavior, and even a pretty comprehensive account of their recorded interactions with humans throughout history! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/f69f48f839db47155693ce9fa10c602d03027f4b.png[/img]
Just like other elements of the world of Flawless Abbey, The Beast was originally confined to paper. Then given life through watercolor to eventually become part of the hand-painted world of wonders we see today!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lVodWZt.gif[/img]

During its initial conception phase, we could have never expected that bringing an entirely hand drawn Dragon from paper to 3D would actually prove to be quite [i]The Beast[/i] in its own right! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/8c8ad01fa85b539b5606a613b2f4166ceba896c1.png[/img]
While other ‘paper-to-3D’ elements found in the game had posed their own unique dilemmas, what we didn't expect is the fact that making an entirely hand drawn Dragon into 3D isn't as easy of a task as we really thought... Unlike other elements which could be modeled with simpler constructs, The Beast had to be sculpted— almost carved out a chunk of polygons, emerging like a figurine from a piece of wood in the hands of a master craftsman.

Next, to make it really come alive it had to be outfitted with a complex skeleton for animations! 

[b]Uh oh, looks like we got spotted![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/b90ea3028302dd3d89b0e1de98187ae254623242.gif[/img]

Another factor that contributed to the overall difficulty was its textures. Just like everything else in the world our fearsome friend inhabits, each texture was hand painted. Usinga complex texture map to breathe life into brushstrokes and create the mesmerizing monster before you 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/0f624f2f6d7a741da1f9db2c1c8de0376ec56b1b.png[/img]

These awe-inspiriing creatures can be your noble companions, or your greatest enemies. Which side do you think our Dragon end up on? 

We hope you’ve all enjoyed this deep dive into the depths of creating this majestic and fearsome creature! Let’s make our exit for now...it looks hungry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/f359c5080b1d80ac4e2500f5ad9d60372b7f81a1.gif[/img]

[b]*chomp*[/b] 🐲

Be sure to keep an eye out for future devlogs and updates! We’ll continue to share peeks at the process of bringing Flawless Abbey to life, and can't wait until you can visit it yourselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/60b652e40783edd81eb3280e63da6a61cdb56e40.gif[/img]

Farewell for now, dear Dream Divers!

[b]Don’t Drag-on and follow our socials for all the latest devlogs, news, + more![/b]

notes.title: Flawless Abbey - Symphony of Sounds
notes.notes:
We are back 🎇 Mystical Passagers 🤩 and we have some updates ✨!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/84176fe70859361afc136f8c17b2fb743440378a.gif[/img]

Soon you will be able to explore the mystical world of Flawless Abbey with a Symphony of New Sounds! 

From footsteps, to paper rustling, sound design is an essential part of building the game’s true vision – it is crucial to build the true atmosphere and express the emotional depth that the story requires. 

Every click, ruffle and melody has a purpose. 

This latest musical addition truly completes the spirit of Flawless Abbey: The stunning and mystical Labyrinth Tower is in reality, a huge music box, a big mechanical orchestra. Everything has its own sound and plays its own music - including each character using their new instruments-voices to play their parts.

To properly create an atmosphere, we used mostly cellos and double bass mixed with glucophone and sounds of birds, thunderstorms and wind. Sometimes, you can hear the abbess whispering poetry-mantras – you might feel inspired, so pay attention.

So, to round up, the current build of the game has: 

➼ Characters with new voices! - now you can hear the characters' language using flutes, xylophones and trombones are now the language of our world!! 

➼ For a brand new experience, we scattered original melodies around.

➼ The elegant and magical Star-Key Box is now a music box – connecting every object and story with a soft melody of connection. 

➼ As you press new objects, we have brand new sounds to connect the mood!; 

➼ New atmospheric sounds that enriching adventure to it’s true level!

notes.title: Lost Dolls - the truth about the test dummies
notes.notes:
Happy Wednesday everyone,

Today we wanted to gift the curious minds some secret lore for our future saviors of Flawless Abbey - we are talking about the figures scattered around Flawless Abbey! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/e1ea727a4e8437295952b3f780f7ee8044cb02b5.jpg[/img]

Before we get into the details, we wanted to show the design process: from the original sketches, to first coloring test, and finally to the end design: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/c60a216c1f863614540c5b8d9892f79f9bc30f91.png[/img]

You can see the coloration evolve from the simple sketch into the final version with more vivid gradients and stronger pigmentation. You can also notice that the figures look like they’ve been painted with watercolor on human-shape paper cut outs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/69e35a4c4e67ec895fd91bcf8a96353f6f58d174.jpg[/img]

Inspecting the design even deeper, you can see that the bodies are made of polished lacquered wood, delicately held together by hinges in their limbs, neck and torso covered by a material that seems to be purple fabric (could it be related to the abbey’s emblem colors?).

We are introduced to the tales of Flawless Abbey through a play performed by these cardboard dolls —  and they can be found all over the game. Just like in dreams, you can’t seem to remember any specific facial feature in any of the characters. With no face nor personality, It seems like they have been drawn by the Abbess and forced to participate in this…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/f279f5c1f047431f051f76b865723a9ada29aa41.gif[/img]

Without a voice, lost in a dream, the figures seem to both be part of the Abbess plans but also seem to be victims of the nightmare that is threatening Flawless Abbey…  could there be more here than we think?

notes.title: Hidden Messages of Flawless Abbey
notes.notes:
Happy Tuesday everyone, today we have a treat for you - Let’s talk Symbols! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/d39e8302bcfe2769c443206d5664fed652338e25.gif[/img]

Throughout Flawless Abbey, you will see these symbols watching you — following you everywhere. What could they mean? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/690c6ffb7d221050db1032bbd5837847ca5704d9.png[/img]

Sometimes they can give you answers, sometimes they might even help you get out of certain traps — you must pay attention to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/160681edc4071a367d158e7b23b6ba1136ae6874.png[/img]

Symbolism in any art medium — whether it’s art, tv or movies, — is always being used as a way to convey a more profound meaning.
Especially in games, everything from color palette, audio choices and background assets is used to either directly contribute to the narrative imagery or indirectly add more lore into your story. 

Symbolism can be applied in different ways — In Flawless Abbey there are a lot of themes being discussed underneath the story.
For today we will focus on lore-related symbolism used in the icons appearing in our main character’s journey.

The Characters of Flawless Abbey are in crisis — the fate of their lives depends on what they do in the real world and what the dream world does to them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/5bee539f1f6434a7bb93efede9f2adf153ecb991.png[/img]

Their only hope for surviving the darkness are the Dream Seekers - the only ones brave enough to travel in between the dream world and the reality. 

The icons scattered around the game each represent one of the Dream Seekers and will be watching and supporting you throughout your journey

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/5bae966ea7735fb6a3f334cac48cba77149abf37.png[/img]

Here is a poem about the legendary Dreamseekers: 

From the purest of hearts, 
The deepest of eyes, 
A sentence that’s finished, even if never starts 
A hand that was free, is taken once more 
A scherzo that’s played with a fiery soul - 
is nothing like you have heard ever before.

Inside the poem, if you pay attention to the verses, you can see who the Dreamseekers are — The Deep Eye, the Free Hand, and others. Try and find them all!

Each Dreamseeker has a talent that distinguishes them from the rest. “(...) nothing like you have heard ever before.” refers to the mythical Dream Seeker known  as The Silent One - who might be deaf, but has a remarkably unique way of exploring silent dreams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/2ba151b13e361633a6f940797fc8f2bbf05610de.png[/img]

If you want to succeed on your journey, you will need to learn the truth about those who have braved the dreams before you. Their guidance will lead you — and you’ll need all the knowledge you can get to complete this mission.

So the question remains — are you ready for the challenge?

notes.title: You are just my type - Why lettering matters
notes.notes:
Happy Tuesday everyone! 

When you are designing a video game, figuring out typography, usually, isn’t a priority — you’d be surprised to hear that good lettering can make or break the aesthetic of your game. Readability, Aesthetics and Purpose are some of the main aspects of the logo to correctly portray the image of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/fe79c833f783ccf33a37419a8a1e49862757deab.png[/img]

Throughout the game Aurora, our main character, will be sketching and taking notes, so it was important to have the logo that looked like a cover for her notebook. 

There were a lot of attempts to create the unique look for the logo. The cursive and overall shape were chosen to resemble  diary entries written by hand during a journey. A Game’s logo will, visually, let your player’s know what type of game it is - the Flawless Abbey’s logo portrays the mysterious and intricate adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/65ae9fd43e5621197200b6854b14009b1874acbe.jpg[/img]

Having symbolism in your logo, complemented with meaningful color choices, will attract the type of players who would enjoy your game and make it stand out from the competition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/2cab6e195b2aa52c278b4b5e790370e883e7105c.png[/img]

What do you think - is typography important for game development?

notes.title: A pigment of your imagination....
notes.notes:
Happy Thursday everyone! 

Today we are talking about the color palette chosen for Flawless Abbey: where everything resembles stained glass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/f892425ae7fc46ef13652148b0f79c105020e99c.gif[/img]

In general, the full game is dominated by the colors purple and lilac. In color psychology purple represents wisdom and spirituality, usually connected to mystery and the unknown. In the game, the colors symbolize the contrast between the dream world and the real world.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/7cb4153b6365c20092af8977c71274d499442fba.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/b9a34a174147069ec90180a8eae1cef1c7d43c3c.jpg[/img]

Stained glass is a coloured glass material that has been used throughout history mainly in churches and other religious buildings. In honor of this historical medium of art, in Flawless Abbey we see elements similar to these iconic colorful windows — lot’s of detail and bright colors in a hazy blue atmosphere. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/3a4219d373e55abee5ef900b126952d7d43e600d.jpg[/img]

And the Labyrinth Tower itself is like a geode which hides a variety of bright colors inside. It’s a temple that represents the colorful nature of the human soul. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/7e486a3f741c5492ef63a3c8efb87085076338ec.png[/img]

What do you think? What do these colors  mean to you?

notes.title: A Flawless Abbey Welcome!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/d7760787496b806a0a6e7977617e720573494ae3.jpg[/img]

Hello Adventurers and Welcome to Flawless Abbey - an enigmatic and delicate new world where you journey through a hand-painted fairytale! 

Navigate your way through the Labyrinth Tower and to find the REAL truth about what happened here…

Without giving much away, here's what you will find in our debut title!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/b9a34a174147069ec90180a8eae1cef1c7d43c3c.jpg[/img]

Through several rooms,  you must figure out the puzzles awaiting you and crank levers to open passages and find out the best way to the top of the tower and to the Truth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40236928/69f6b689869ec89148cdc976e25cff1452611d68.png[/img]

While you figure your way around the rooms… Enjoy:
➤ Hand-painted landscapes incorporated in a 3D world 
➤ A musically-infused journey 
➤ An Engaging and intriguing Narrative 

Oh! Before I forget, one last tip, since we are friends now: Make your choices wisely as your decisions will have an impact on what ending you will get.

See you at the top!
